messages:
eve_customer: Hey team — our rerank calls started failing this morning with a 413 and an ""input too large"" message. Happens when query + docs > ~1.2M chars? No detailed error. stack: production, env=prod-us.
alice_support: Sorry about that, @eve_customer. Can you paste the exact request (sanitized) or curl you used and the count/average size of docs? Also which model/endpoint (rerank) and SDK or direct API?
eve_customer: Sure — direct API. curl shown below (sanitised):\n\n```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query":"<very long query ~120k chars>", "documents":[{"id":"d1","text":"<~30k chars>"}, ... 120 docs] }'
```
\nWe typically send ~120 docs per call, average doc ~25-35k chars. We recently expanded query size for an advanced re-ranking step. Response is just 413 with JSON: `\{"error\":\"payload too large\"\}` — no token count or guidance.
alice_support: Thanks. Two-track: 1) quick mitigation steps for your app, 2) escalate to eng/product to improve error messaging and limit docs.
alice_support: Quick mitigation: a) send fewer docs per call (split into batches of 20–30), b) truncate documents to snippet/passages (use top-k passages per doc), or c) avoid extremely long single queries — try summarizing or sending it in passages. We can provide code samples if you want.
eve_customer: We can batch, but latency matters. Splitting adds overhead and we hit rate limits. We need a recommended batching pattern or a way to know the exact token/char limit to do client-side checks.
sam_sre: @alice_support FYI I pulled the request logs for that root trace id. The service rejects on our max_payload_bytes check in the reranker gateway. Current env limit is 4MB for request body. That aligns with a 413. The code path doesn't translate bytes -> tokens, so no token count in error. We're also seeing some requests hitting memory pressure during KV cache allocation for huge queries.
ben_engineer: Thanks for the logs, @sam_sre. Confirming: the gateway enforces a 4MB raw body limit. Rerank internally also has a soft token limit (~32k tokens) but we only enforce at model runtime and return a different error when reached. For these calls the gateway blocks earlier with 413. I can add more diagnostic fields to the 413 payload (current_body_bytes, max_body_bytes) so clients can understand and auto-chunk. Thoughts @carla_prod?
carla_prod: +1 on diagnostics. UX request: message should be actionable — e.g., "Request body X bytes exceeds limit Y. Suggestions: send <=N docs or split into batches of M docs or pass passages (example curl)." Also add link to KB with sample chunking patterns and a recommended batch size table by average doc size.
alice_support: @ben_engineer can you also add a suggested sample snippet in the KB for chunking server-side (streaming style) and a client-side helper to estimate bytes from string lengths? That would help customers avoid trial-and-error.
ben_engineer: Will do. I'll open a PR to change the 413 response body to JSON with fields: `error`, `current_body_bytes`, `max_body_bytes`, and `help_url`. I'll also add a note about our soft token ceiling and that very long queries may still fail at model runtime. ETA: I can get a patch up today for the message; deployment in next canary window.
carla_prod: Great. @alice_support can you prep a short KB update and email template for outbound support responses so CS teams can advise on batching/summary patterns? Include examples for: small docs (<=2k chars) -> batch 50, medium docs (2k-10k) -> batch 20, large docs (>10k) -> split into passages and batch 5–10.
alice_support: On it. I'll draft and link it here when ready.
eve_customer: That works — thanks. Could you also recommend a quick client-side check to estimate whether a payload will breach 4MB before sending? We can implement quickly.
alice_support: Sure — simplest: serialize the request JSON and check `Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(payload), 'utf8')` in JS or equivalent in other languages. If > (max_body_bytes - safety_margin) then split. We'll include code examples in the KB.
ben_engineer: Pushed a small change to the error payload in staging. @deploy-bot can you kick a canary deploy for rerank-gateway/stage?
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for rerank-gateway/stage at 2026-03-17T14:05:00Z :rocket:
ben_engineer: Canary looks clean. Error response now returns: `{ "error": "request_too_large", "current_body_bytes": 5242881, "max_body_bytes": 4194304, "help_url": "https://docs.redwood.com/rerank#chunking" }` — sample values shown.
carla_prod: Nice. Please add a short paragraph in docs explaining the difference between body-size limit and token limit so customers don't conflate them.
alice_support: KB draft: will paste shortly. Meanwhile @eve_customer do you want us to whitelist your org for temporary higher body-size for a migration run? That would require elevated provisioning — talk to sales/entitlements. If urgent we can do a one-off workaround.
eve_customer: Not needed — we'll implement batching and the JS check. Appreciate the quick turnaround and clearer errors. :thumbsup:
alice_support: Closing loop here — KB and PR links: https://docs.redwood.com/rerank#chunking (draft), PR #4521 (error payload). Reopen if you hit anything else."
